title: CMB signatures of gravity-mediated dark radiation in $\mathbf{ΔN_{\rm eff}}$
summary: Measurement of $N_{\rm eff}$ in the CMB (Cosmic Microwave Background) observations, like Planck 2018 and BBN (Big Bang Nucleosynthesis) has already set stringent constraints on the interaction strength of light particles beyond the Standard Model (BSM). Despite such negligible couplings of such BSM particles to the visible sector, they are inevitably produced in the early universe through gravity-mediated processes.
